title: Cue-driven stroke drawing, reveal and packet flow
description: Existing seek-safe GSAP helpers for drawing geometry, revealing a subject and transporting an element between coordinates.
usage: The pipeline already loads window.VideoMotion from assets/motion.js; this bundle preserves the original helpers. API: VideoMotion.draw(tl, target, cue.localAt, {duration, length}); VideoMotion.flow(tl, target, cue.localAt, {duration, fromX, toX, fromY, toY}); VideoMotion.reveal(tl, target, cue.localAt, {duration, x, y, scale}). Supply a paused GSAP timeline and instance-specific selectors. These are primitives, not complete explanatory sequences. No additional script tag is needed in current pipeline jobs.
